entries.title: Proverbs 15:1
segments: A soft answer turns away wrath, but grievous words stir up anger.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:2
segments: The tongue of the wise uses knowledge rightly, but the mouth of fools pours out foolishness.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:3
segments: The eyes of the LORD [are] in every place, beholding the evil and the good.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:4
segments: A wholesome tongue [is] a tree of life, but crookedness in it [is] a break in the spirit.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:5
segments: A fool despises his father's instruction, but he who listens to correction is wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:6
segments: In the house of the righteous [is] much treasure, but in the gain of the wicked [is] trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:7
segments: The lips of the righteous send forth knowledge, but the heart of the foolish [is] not so.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:8
segments: The sacrifice of the wicked [is] a hateful thing to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright [is] His delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:9
segments: The way of the wicked [is] hateful to the LORD, but He loves him who pursues righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:10
segments: Correction [is] grievous to him who forsakes the way; he who hates reproof shall die.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:11
segments: Hell and destruction [are] before the LORD; even more the hearts of the sons of men?

entries.title: Proverbs 15:12
segments: A scorner does not love one who corrects him, nor will he go to the wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:13
segments: A merry heart makes a cheerful face, but by sorrow of heart the spirit is broken.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:14
segments: The heart of him who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouth of fools feeds on foolishness.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:15
segments: All the days of the afflicted [are] evil, but gladness of heart is a continual a feast.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:16
segments: Better [is] a little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and tumult with it.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:17
segments: Better [is] a dinner of vegetables where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred with it.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:18
segments: A wrathful man stirs up fighting, but one slow to anger calms fighting.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:19
segments: The way of the lazy one [is] like a hedge of thorns, but the way of the righteous [is] made plain.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:20
segments: A wise son makes a glad father, but a foolish man despises his mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:21
segments: Folly [is] joy to him who is without any wisdom, but a man of understanding walks uprightly.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:22
segments: Without wisdom, purposes are defeated, but by many wise men they are established.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:23
segments: A man [has] joy by the answer of his mouth, and a word in due season, how good [it is]!

entries.title: Proverbs 15:24
segments: The way of life [is] above to the wise, so that he may turn away from hell below.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:25
segments: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud, but He will set up the border of the widow.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:26
segments: The thoughts of the wicked [are] very hateful to the LORD, but the words of the pure [are] pleasant words.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:27
segments: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes shall live.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:28
segments: The heart of the righteous studies to answer, but the mouth of the wicked pours out evil things.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:29
segments: The LORD [is] far from the wicked, but He hears the prayer of the righteous.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:30
segments: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart; a good report makes the bones fat.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:31
segments: The ear that hears the reproof of life shall remain among the wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:32
segments: He who refuses instruction despises his own soul, but he who hears reproof gets understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 15:33
segments: The fear of the LORD [is] the instruction of wisdom, and before honor [is] humility.
